title: Claims ledger entry (v2)
description: One JSON object per line in stage4_writing/claims_ledger.jsonl. Linked from state-contract.md. Validate with: `jsonschema -i <line> claims_ledger.schema.json`.

schema_version.description: Pinned to 2 — readers must hard-fail on other versions.

claim_id.description: Stable identifier; the Inspector uses this in URL fragments.

value.description: The displayed number — 73.4 for a `73.4%` cell, not 0.734.

metric.description: Free-form metric name; matches columns in results.csv when applicable.

config_name.description: The config the value belongs to, or null for cross-config aggregates.

seed.description: Seed when the value is per-seed; null for aggregates.

paper_tex_locator.description: <file>:L<line> or <file>:L<line>:C<col>. Same convention used by trace_numbers.py and the frontend tokenizer.

source.description: Human-readable pointer to the evidence (results.csv:row=N, results_summary.json:<dotted>, literature_pool:<key>:abstract, ...).
